subject.zh: 征召兵的徽记：一支朴素的铁头长枪与一把木柄干草叉交叉成 X 形，交叉处缠着一段粗麻布条 #C9B98F，枪头铁灰 #8A8780，木柄浅褐 #9A7448。辨识：长枪与干草叉交叉，像临时拿起武器的农人。
subject.en: Insignia of levied conscripts: a plain iron-headed spear and a wooden pitchfork crossed in an X, a strip of coarse sackcloth #C9B98F bound where they cross, gray iron head #8A8780, light brown wooden hafts #9A7448. Identifying mark: spear and pitchfork crossed, like farmers who just picked up arms.
